readerEvidence.summary: All9 current prepared pages personally visually read after preparation completed, including blank solution page6; full remote2015 inventory inspected. Six shared-chart tasks consolidated under existing p1 with native sections and p2–p6 aliases. All supplied English key charts, scoring,20-row Messier table and general instructions preserved. No independent model checker and no inferred missing answers.
sourceGaps: The official key numbers the five brightest stellar positions but supplies no explicit list of their names. For part 6 it gives angular tolerances only, without a numerical Nunki–Shaula separation.
sourceDiscrepancies: The Messier key table repeats M20 with different magnitude/size entries; original wording Magnitudo and Nova Sagitarii labels are retained.
